text:
Three types of radiation are α-radiation, β-radiation and γ-radiation.
Which statement is correct?
α-radiation is less ionising than β-radiation.
A
α-radiation is less ionising than γ-radiation.
B
γ-radiation produces no ionisation.
C
β-radiation is more ionising than γ-radiation.
D

options.label: A
options.text: α-radiation is less ionising than β-radiation.

options.label: B
options.text: α-radiation is less ionising than γ-radiation.

options.label: D
options.text: β-radiation is more ionising than γ-radiation.
